newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper down on higher local offerings.
newsitem.headline: India copper down on higher local offerings.

text.p: Copper prices extended losses on the metal market with other base metals steady in limited activity on Monday, dealers said.
Copper prices fell further by 75 rupees at 13,250 rupees per quintal on the back of higher offerings by local producers including state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd.

Sluggish industrial demand subdued market sentiment. Copper was down by 175 rupees per quintal last week while Hindustan Copper Ltd. had reduced selling prices by 1,000/4,000 rupees per tonne for August.
Zinc, tin and nickel consolidated recent gains amid limited inflow but offtake was at a low ebb.

Zinc was steady at 8,400 rupees per quintal after gaining 50 rupees last week while tin was quiet at 29,200 rupees as was nickel at 34,300 rupees per quintal. Tin was up by 200 rupees and nickel was up by 500 rupees per quintal last week.

Aluminium was indicated at the previous level of 7,800 rupees asowas lead at 4,200 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading. State-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd. hiked zinc selling prices by 2,000 rupees per tonne for August last week, while lead prices were unchanged.
